A.domain: Arithmetic with fractions and mixed numbers (subtraction, equivalent fractions, simplification)

skills.name: Convert mixed to improper
skills.definition: Convert a mixed number (or whole number) into an equivalent improper fraction with a specified denominator.
inclusion_criteria: A step rewrites a mixed number a b/c as (a·c+b)/c
A step rewrites a whole number as an equivalent fraction n = (n·d)/d to match a denominator
exclusion_criteria: Only finding a common denominator between two proper fractions without any mixed/whole-number conversion
Only simplifying a fraction after subtraction

skills.name: Find common denominator
skills.definition: Determine a common denominator (often via LCM) and rewrite fractions as equivalent fractions with that denominator.
inclusion_criteria: A step explicitly finds/uses LCM or otherwise selects a common denominator for unlike denominators
A step scales numerator and denominator to create equivalent fractions with the chosen common denominator
exclusion_criteria: Denominators are already equal and the work proceeds directly to subtract numerators
Only converting mixed numbers to improper fractions without addressing unlike denominators

skills.name: Subtract rational numbers
skills.definition: Compute the difference of two rational numbers by subtracting numerators over a common denominator (including cases yielding 0 or an integer).
inclusion_criteria: A step performs the subtraction once fractions share a denominator (e.g., a/b − c/b = (a−c)/b)
A step subtracts equal fractions or equivalent quantities to obtain 0
A step subtracts whole and fractional parts (or uses an equivalent decomposition) to get the difference
exclusion_criteria: Only setting up equivalent fractions/common denominators without executing the subtraction
Only simplifying/reducing the final fraction without performing the subtraction

skills.name: Simplify and format result
skills.definition: Reduce a fraction to lowest terms and/or express an improper fraction as a mixed number or integer as an acceptable final form.
inclusion_criteria: A step states the result is in lowest terms or performs reduction (e.g., 21/12 = 7/4)
A step converts an improper fraction to a mixed number (e.g., 6/5 = 1 1/5) or to an integer (e.g., 3/3 = 1)
exclusion_criteria: Only performing the subtraction without any reduction or re-expression
Only finding a common denominator or converting mixed numbers prior to subtraction

B.domain: Arithmetic with fractions and mixed numbers (subtraction, equivalent fractions, simplification)

skills.name: Convert mixed numbers
skills.definition: Convert between mixed numbers, improper fractions, and whole numbers written as fractions to enable computation.
inclusion_criteria: A step rewrites a mixed number (e.g., 3 1/2) as an improper fraction (e.g., 7/2)
A step rewrites a whole number (e.g., 3) as a fraction with a specified denominator (e.g., 15/5)
A step re-expresses a nonstandard mixed form like 1 4/3 as an improper fraction
exclusion_criteria: Only finding a common denominator without converting mixed/whole numbers
Only subtracting numerators after denominators already match
Only simplifying/reducing a fraction after subtraction

skills.name: Find common denominator
skills.definition: Determine and use a common denominator (often via LCM) to rewrite fractions as equivalent fractions with the same denominator.
inclusion_criteria: A step explicitly finds an LCM or chooses a common denominator for two denominators
A step scales numerator/denominator to create equivalent fractions with the chosen common denominator
exclusion_criteria: Denominators are already the same and no conversion is needed
Only converting mixed numbers to improper fractions without addressing denominators
Only performing the subtraction once denominators already match

skills.name: Subtract rational numbers
skills.definition: Compute the difference of two rational numbers once they are expressed with compatible forms (same denominator or separated whole/fraction parts).
inclusion_criteria: A step subtracts two fractions with the same denominator by subtracting numerators
A step subtracts two improper fractions after conversion/common denominator
A step subtracts mixed numbers by subtracting whole parts and fractional parts
exclusion_criteria: Only rewriting numbers (conversion) without performing subtraction
Only simplifying the result after subtraction
Only selecting a common denominator without subtracting

skills.name: Simplify final result
skills.definition: Express the computed result in an accepted simplest form (reduce to lowest terms and/or convert between improper fraction and mixed number/whole number).
inclusion_criteria: A step reduces a fraction to lowest terms (e.g., 21/12 to 7/4)
A step states or checks that a fraction is already in lowest terms
A step converts an improper fraction to a mixed number or identifies a whole-number result (e.g., 3/3 = 1, or result 0)
exclusion_criteria: Only performing subtraction without any reduction or form conversion
Only finding a common denominator or converting mixed numbers as setup
Rounding/decimal approximation as the primary operation (not present as a required step here)

C.domain: Rational number arithmetic (fraction and mixed-number subtraction)

skills.name: Convert mixed to improper
skills.definition: Convert mixed numbers (and whole numbers when needed) into equivalent improper fractions with a specified denominator.
inclusion_criteria: A step rewrites a mixed number a b/c as (a·c+b)/c
A step rewrites a whole number as an equivalent fraction n = (n·d)/d to match a denominator
exclusion_criteria: Only simplifying a fraction (e.g., 21/12 = 7/4) without converting from mixed/whole form
Only finding a common denominator between two proper fractions without any mixed/whole conversion

skills.name: Find common denominator
skills.definition: Determine a common denominator (often via LCM) and rewrite fractions as equivalent fractions over that denominator.
inclusion_criteria: A step explicitly finds an LCM or chooses a common denominator for unlike denominators
A step scales numerator and denominator to express each fraction with the common denominator
exclusion_criteria: Denominators are already equal and the work proceeds directly to subtract numerators
Only converting mixed/whole numbers to improper fractions without addressing unlike denominators

skills.name: Subtract rational numbers
skills.definition: Compute the difference of two rational numbers once they are expressed in compatible forms (same denominator or separated whole/fraction parts).
inclusion_criteria: A step subtracts numerators over a common denominator (e.g., a/b − c/b)
A step subtracts by combining whole and fractional parts (e.g., (A−B)+(a/b−c/b))
A step recognizes identical quantities subtract to 0
exclusion_criteria: Only rewriting/setting up equivalent fractions without performing the subtraction
Only simplifying the resulting fraction after subtraction

skills.name: Simplify and format result
skills.definition: Reduce the computed result to lowest terms and/or express it in an accepted final form (integer, improper fraction, or mixed number).
inclusion_criteria: A step reduces a fraction by dividing numerator and denominator by a common factor
A step converts an improper fraction to a mixed number (or notes the mixed-number equivalent)
A step states the result is already in lowest terms
exclusion_criteria: Any step whose main purpose is finding a common denominator before subtraction
Any step that performs the subtraction but does not simplify or format the final value
